additional_info.subject: RE: 0403612 - ID0403612-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] FW Update CRM:02023000474
additional_info.body:
Dear Luca Rizzi,
Greetings of the day!
We’ve updated the charger MP / R6 170002083 to the latest firmware version V6.0.3. However, charger MP / RD 170003110 is currently offline on SCB, so we are unable to update its firmware. Could you kindly ask the end customer to try a hard reset via OCPP or attempt rebooting the charger locally to bring it back online?
If the charger remains offline after these steps, we will need to arrange a site visit to inspect the router settings and assess the network signal strength.
Please let us know if you require any further assistance
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
